title: Out-of-box pass: structural findings + falsifications

findings.residual_fat_tail: excess kurtosis 0.40, right tail fatter (+2.8 at q=0.99) — real but two-piece/asymmetric constructions all lose to symmetric gaussian+atoms
findings.mu_grid_structure: 1175 games have integer mu (integer residuals), 1287 have half-mu (half-point residuals). Residual atoms genuinely sit on different grids by mu parity.
findings.signed_atoms: P(+3) vs P(-3) differ ~15% relative by favorite side — real signal the harness's symmetric atoms cannot express
findings.why_parity_and_signed_lose: my GH-quadrature continuous part carries +0.03 CRPS bias vs the harness's exact crps_energy — big enough to swamp 0.002-level gains. To express signed/parity atoms in the harness engine requires modifying crps_energy itself (out of scope: protected harness).

falsified_this_pass: GH bias swamps gain; needs harness modification
engine bias only +0.003; skew signal (0.174 vs 0.042) is real but doesn't convert to CRPS — the two-piece shape costs more than the skew fit gains
verdict: champion v3 (7.134568) survived EVERY structural challenger: asymmetric tails, parity grids, signed atoms, skew shapes, mixtures, KDE. The margin CRPS on the frozen filter is essentially exhausted for public information. Remaining gap to gate (0.0356) requires either harness-engine changes (protected) or new paid data planes.
